title: Remove formatter progress flat alias
summary: Removed the remaining formatters.js flat window alias for formatProgressValue. Home, topbar lifecycle, and Progress now resolve that helper from window.mediaPipelineFormatters, and the WebView contract/inventory totals were refreshed to 647 flat exports across 50 files.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in a small shared-formatter domain while preserving namespace-first access and read-only frontend boundaries.
behavior_before: formatters.js exposed formatProgressValue both through mediaPipelineFormatters and as window.formatProgressValue, with Progress/Home/topbar fixtures depending on the flat global shape.
behavior_after: formatProgressValue remains available through mediaPipelineFormatters only; Progress, Home, and topbar lifecycle bind a local helper from that namespace, and formatters.js has zero flat exports.
tests_added: Tightened Local API static assertions so formatProgressValue must be a mediaPipelineFormatters member and no longer a flat window alias.
Moved WebView VM fixtures for Progress/Home/topbar formatter access to the mediaPipelineFormatters namespace shape and covered Progress namespace binding.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted WebView static formatter/progress/home group found an existing VM fixture gap: test_home_recent_completed_prefers_episode_identity_for_tv_rows lacked setText; fixture was updated in this packet and the group reran OK.
rollback_plan: Restore window.formatProgressValue = formatProgressValue in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/formatters.js, switch Progress/Home/topbar formatter fixture assertions back to flat global access as needed, regenerate the WebView public contract and inventory totals, refresh summaries, and rerun the same static/API/browser checks.
